chunks: Muhammad ibn 'Ali ibn Mahbub, from Ahmad, from al-Husayn, from Fadalah, from Ibn Muskan, from Abi Basir, from Abi 'Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:

“My father performed ghusl from janabah, and it was said to him: A small spot on your back has remained which the water did not reach. So he said to him: What would it have been upon you had you remained silent? Then he wiped that spot with his hand.”

key_terms.الْجَنَابَةِ: the state of janabah requiring ritual bathing
key_terms.لُمْعَةٌ: a small patch or spot on the body left dry

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about a missed dry spot during ghusl from janabah?
ai.summary: This hadith reports an incident concerning ghusl from janabah, where a small dry spot was noticed after washing. The Imam عليه السلام mentions the remark made to his father and then states that he wiped the spot with his hand, making the report relevant to discussions of ritual purity and the rulings of ghusl.
